Agent: Certainly! Systematic scanning techniques are methods used to observe your surroundings thoroughly and efficiently. One common technique is the "Clock Face Method":

1. Imagine your field of view as a clock face
2. Start at 12 o'clock and scan clockwise, pausing briefly at each hour mark
3. Focus on different distances for each sweep (near, middle, far)
4. Pay attention to anything unusual or out of place

This method helps ensure you don't miss any areas and trains your brain to be more observant. It's particularly useful when patrolling on foot or monitoring a stationary area. With practice, it becomes second nature. Have you tried any specific observation techniques during your patrols?
